# UISet catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.mjs from the registry. -->

Install any item with `npx shadcn@latest add @uiset/<item>`. Docs: https://uiset.dev/docs/README.md (or `docs/` in the repo).

## Root (docs/theming.md)

- `uiset`: The UISet root: skins, a key color, and sound and haptics for every UI SDK component inside it.

## App frame and data display (docs/app-shell.md)

- `app-shell`: A sidebar layout that collapses to icons with Mod+B, remembers it, and becomes a drawer on narrow screens; with sidebar navigation.
- `breadcrumbs`: Where you are, with the current page marked.
- `page-header`: A page title with description and actions.
- `card`: A bordered block with header, title, description, content and footer.
- `badge`: A short status label in five tones, readable in every skin, and a count badge for the corner of an icon or avatar.
- `stat`: A number with its change, said in words as well as color, and an optional trend sparkline.
- `empty-state`: What to do when there's nothing here yet.
- `skeleton`: Loading placeholders, and a Loading region that announces once.
- `description-list`: Terms and their details.
- `item-list`: Rows with media, title, description, meta and actions.
- `alert`: An inline message in four tones that names its tone, interrupts only when urgent, and can be dismissed.
- `kbd`: Keys written the way this platform writes them.
- `spinner`: A loading indicator that says what's loading.
- `stepper`: Steps of a flow with the current one marked and later ones locked.
- `search-field`: A search box with a clear button and a key that focuses it from anywhere.
- `copy-button`: Copies a value and says so.
- `table`: A plain HTML table in a scroll area: sticky headings, a sticky first column, and rows that stack into labelled blocks on narrow screens.
- `avatar-group`: Avatars stacked in a row, with a count of the ones that don't fit.
- `code-block`: Code in its language's colors with a file name, line numbers, marked lines and a copy button; tabs for versions of the same code; and one command for npm, pnpm, yarn and bun that remembers the choice.

## Forms (docs/forms.md)

- `schema-form`: A form from one definition: its fields with UISet's controls, steps with a review, checks as people type and on submit, and an agent that fills it by field name while a person approves the submit. The same definition is JSON Schema for an agent tool.
- `inline-edit`: Text you edit where it shows: press it, Enter or F2 to edit, Enter to save, Escape to cancel, with validation and optional Save and Cancel buttons.
- `upload`: A drop zone and a queue of uploads on UI SDK's File input: each file's preview, progress and status, with cancel, retry and remove, a few going up at a time, to whatever storage you use.

## Rich text (docs/rich-text.md)

- `rich-text`: A rich text editor on UI SDK with no editor library: headings, nested and numbered lists, to-dos, quotes, code, links, mentions, dividers and images; a toolbar, Markdown as you type, "/" for blocks and "@" for people (TriggerMenu); safe paste from documents and the web; undo; Markdown and clean HTML out; agents read and write Markdown.

## Chat (docs/chat.md)

- `chat`: A conversation built on UI SDK: thread that follows new messages, messages with avatars, actions and versions, suggestions, plans and a thinking shimmer.
- `chat-response`: Streaming markdown that repairs itself mid-stream and never renders raw HTML, with code blocks highlighted by skin colors.
- `chat-parts`: Reasoning that opens while the model thinks, tool calls with status, input and output, sources, citations and images.
- `chat-composer`: The message box: Enter to send, history with ArrowUp, slash commands and mentions, attachments by drop, paste or picker, a model picker and a usage meter.
- `chat-sidebar`: A list of chats with rename and confirmed delete, and a floating assistant launcher.

## Data grid (docs/data-grid.md)

- `data-grid`: A spreadsheet-grade grid on UI SDK: virtualized rows, sorting, filters, grouping, pinned, resizable and movable columns, row and cell selection, inline editing with validation, clipboard copy and paste, CSV export, a saved layout and agent actions.

## Charts (docs/charts.md)

- `chart`: The frame every UISet chart shares: title, a legend that isolates series, a Chart/Table switch with the table twin, a keyboard listbox of data positions, tooltips, palettes validated for color blindness per skin, and agent actions.
- `line-chart`: Trends over time: one or more lines, a soft area for one series, or stacked areas, with a crosshair that lists every series and labels at line ends.
- `bar-chart`: Categories compared: columns or horizontal bars, grouped or stacked, ranked, with thin marks and values at the tips.
- `scatter-chart`: Two measures per item, up to three groups, with hover that finds the nearest point.
- `heatmap`: Magnitude on a grid in one hue, with a scale and arrows that move by cell and by row.
- `segmented-bar`: One whole split into up to six parts, with shares printed where they fit: the readable answer to a donut.
- `sparkline`: A trend inside text, a table cell or a stat, whose name says where the values went. Works in Server Components.

## Board (docs/board.md)

- `board`: A kanban board on UI SDK createTransfer: one tab stop, arrows across cards and columns, Space to carry a card, drag with the pointer, column limits, add in place, a details dialog to edit, move or delete, filters, and agent actions.

## Scheduler (docs/scheduler.md)

- `scheduler`: Calendars on UI SDK createSpans: a week, a day or a room timeline where people draw, move and resize events with the pointer or arrows, overlapping events sharing lanes, a month view, a toolbar, an event dialog, and agent actions.

## Canvas (docs/canvas.md)

- `canvas`: A node editor on UI SDK's canvas behaviors: pan and zoom, drag nodes or move them with Alt and arrows, spatial focus, Shift-drag box selection, wires drawn by pointer or with C and arrows, a minimap, zoom controls, a toolbar, an inspector, undo, and agent actions.

## IDE (docs/ide.md)

- `ide`: A code editor's parts on UI SDK: a file tree on Tree with version control marks and New, Rename, Move and Delete; editor tabs on Tabs; a code editor with syntax colors, indenting and problems; a command palette on Command; problems and a status bar.

## Mobile (docs/mobile.md)

- `mobile`: Phone app parts on UI SDK: rows that swipe aside to actions (createSwipeActions), wheel pickers and a time wheel (bindScrollPicker), bottom sheets and action sheets (Drawer), pull to refresh, an app bar and a tab bar.

## Terminal (docs/terminal.md)

- `terminal`: A terminal on UI SDK's input history and stick-to-bottom: ANSI colors kept readable in every skin, links, streaming commands with progress lines, Tab completion, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+L, built-in help, clear and history, and agent actions.

## Studio (docs/studio-kit.md)

- `knob`: A rotary control built as a UI SDK primitive: drag, arrow keys, log scales, double-click reset, agent actions.
- `patch-bay`: Jacks and cables built on UI SDK createConnect: patch by drag, keyboard or agent.
- `fader`: A vertical UI SDK slider with its label and readout.
- `level-meter`: A UI SDK meter drawn as an LED ladder.
- `step-sequencer`: A row of steps built on UI SDK ToggleGroup, with downbeats and a playhead.

## Agent Console (docs/agent-console.md)

- `agent-console`: The human side of the UI SDK agent bridge: approvals in your app, an activity feed with undo, highlights where the agent changed something, a thread and a prompt.

## Agent readiness (docs/agent-check.md)

- `agent-check`: Checks whether an agent can use a page: every control named, each name finding one control, and none that only looks clickable, with a score. Through a UI SDK app's agent bridge, or by reading any site's accessibility tree. In a test (expectAgentReady, expectPageReady), on a page in Playwright, from the command line, or drawn over the page (showAgentReadiness).

## UI SDK components (API and keys: UI SDK's docs)

- `button`: A button in solid, outline and ghost variants.
- `switch`: An on and off switch, with its thumb in place.
- `slider`: A range slider whose track, fill and named thumbs render in one line.
- `segmented-control`: One choice among a few, in a row with a moving indicator.
- `select`: Choose from a list in a popup; the trigger shows what's chosen.
- `field`: A label, control, description and error, connected for screen readers.
- `dialog`: A modal window for a focused task, closed by Escape or its close button.
- `tabs`: Panels that share one space, switched by a row of tabs.
- `accordion`: Sections that open one or many at a time.
- `alert-dialog`: A confirmation that interrupts, with agent confirmation built in.
- `autocomplete`: Free text with suggestions as you type.
- `avatar`: A person's image with initials as the fallback.
- `calendar`: A month grid for picking dates, ready to use as is.
- `carousel`: Slides with previous and next controls and keyboard paging.
- `checkbox`: A checkbox with its check mark, and checkbox groups.
- `collapsible`: One section that shows and hides.
- `color-picker`: Area, hue and alpha sliders, swatch and hex input, ready to use.
- `combobox`: Search a list and choose one or several.
- `command`: A searchable list of commands, for palettes and launchers.
- `date-input`: A date typed segment by segment, in the reader's locale.
- `date-picker`: A date field with a calendar popup.
- `drawer`: A panel that slides in from an edge.
- `file-input`: Choose, drop or paste files, with validation.
- `hover-card`: A preview that opens on hover or focus.
- `image-cropper`: Crop, zoom, rotate and flip an image.
- `input`: A text field, with clear button and groups.
- `label`: A label for any control.
- `listbox`: An always-visible list to choose from.
- `menu`: Actions from a button or a right click, with submenus.
- `menubar`: An application menu bar.
- `meter`: A measurement within a range, ready to use.
- `navigation-menu`: Site navigation with panels.
- `number-input`: A number field with named step buttons, ready to use.
- `otp-input`: A one-time code field with a slot per character.
- `pagination`: Page links with named previous and next, ready to use.
- `password-input`: A password field with a show toggle.
- `popover`: A panel beside its trigger.
- `preferences`: User preferences applied as data attributes and saved.
- `progress`: Progress of a task, ready to use.
- `radio`: Radio groups with their dot, and cards that choose an option wherever you press.
- `rating`: A star rating, ready to use.
- `resizable`: Panels you resize by dragging or with the keyboard.
- `scroll-area`: Styled scrolling, plus ScrollBox with the parts in place.
- `separator`: A line between content.
- `textarea`: Multi-line text that can grow with its content.
- `time-input`: A time typed segment by segment.
- `timeline`: Events in order, with markers and a connecting line.
- `toast`: Notifications, with a Toaster ready to render once.
- `toggle`: Pressed buttons and toggle groups.
- `token-input`: Text mixed with tokens for files, people or tags.
- `toolbar`: Buttons and toggles with one tab stop.
- `tooltip`: A short hint on hover or focus.
- `tree`: A hierarchy you expand and select.
- `trigger-menu`: Suggestions after @, / or # in a text field.
- `waterfall`: Spans on a time axis, like request timings or a trace.

## Templates (docs/templates.md)

- `auth`: Sign in, sign up, forgot and reset password, and verify a code: native validation, server messages, autocomplete hints and a password strength meter.
- `dashboard`: A date range that scopes everything: figures with trends, revenue, orders by channel, plan mix and recent orders.
- `settings`: Profile, security and sessions, notifications, billing with usage and invoices, team with invites and removal, and a danger zone.
- `admin`: A records list with search, filters, columns and export; create and edit in a drawer; inline edits; confirmed bulk delete; an empty state.
- `inbox`: Mail in three panes: folders, a message list you arrow through, the message with star, archive and delete, and compose.
- `chat-app`: The chat kit as a product: chats, a thread and a composer, with your model plugged in as an async stream of events.
- `ide-app`: A code editor in resizable panes: files with version control marks, tabs, an editor with syntax colors, a command palette (files, commands, lines), problems, an outline and a status bar.
- `project-board`: A project's issues as a board or a list: sprint progress, search and an assignee filter, column limits, card details, a new-issue form and Undo on moves.
- `calendar-app`: A calendar app: day, week and month views, a small month to jump to a day, calendars to show or hide, what's next, and events created, edited and deleted in a dialog.
- `pricing`: Plans with a monthly or yearly switch, a recommended plan, a comparison table and questions.
